disable_ipv6.description: Disable IPv6 globally and on loopback to reduce attack surface.

log_suspicious_packets.description: Log packets with impossible addresses (martians) for forensic analysis.

core_pattern.description: Path or pipe command for core dump handling. Use |/bin/false to disable core dumps securely.

disable_core_dumps.description: Prevent dumping of memory to core files (blocks sensitive data leakage).

enforce_selinux.description: Enable SELinux at boot (requires SELinux support in kernel and filesystem).

harden_memory.description: Raise minimum mmap address to prevent NULL pointer dereference exploitation and increase ASLR entropy.

disable_userns.description: Disable user namespaces to block unprivileged container escapes and privilege escalation attacks.

stack_protector.description: Enable kernel stack protector (requires kernel compiled with CONFIG_CC_STACKPROTECTOR=y).

tcp_tw_reuse.description: Allow reusing TIME-WAIT sockets for new connections (set to false for stricter hardening).

bpf_jit_harden.description: Enable BPF JIT hardening level 2 (constant blinding, no unsafe writes) — improves BPF JIT exploit resistance.
